nameEn: Manufacture of machinery for food, beverage and tobacco processing
description: This class includes the manufacture of machinery used in the processing of food, beverages and tobacco.
includes: manufacture of machinery for the preparation of meat, fish, vegetables and similar food products
manufacture of bakery ovens and other machinery for the preparation of baked goods
manufacture of machinery for the manufacture of confectionery, cocoa products, chocolate
manufacture of machinery for the industrial preparation of beverages
manufacture of machinery for the preparation of tobacco and tobacco products
manufacture of dairy machinery: machinery for processing milk, butter, cheese
manufacture of machinery for the industrial preparation of food fats and oils
manufacture of presses, crushers and similar machinery for making wine, cider, fruit juices
manufacture of agricultural dryers for fruits, vegetables and nuts
excludes: manufacture of domestic kitchen appliances, see 2750
